name: Bal'lal Ruins
summary: Bloodscalp trolls guard Bal'lal Ruins on Stranglethorn Vale's northwestern shore, north of Grom'gol Base Camp. The old Gurubashi stones overlook the Vile Reef.

sections.title: A Crumbling Outpost on the Reef
sections.body: Bloodscalp trolls keep watch among the weathered stones of Bal'lal Ruins above the Vile Reef. The site lies on Stranglethorn Vale's coast, north of Grom'gol Base Camp. These stones remain from the Gurubashi Empire, the troll civilization that once ruled southern Azeroth. Cracked walls mark the ruins' long decay, and Bloodscalp trolls defend these ancestral relics against intruders.

faq.answer: The Bloodscalp tribe occupies Bal'lal Ruins and guards the territory against outsiders, travelers, and rivals.

faq.q: Where are the Bal'lal Ruins located?
faq.answer: Bal'lal Ruins lie on Stranglethorn Vale's northwestern coast, north of Grom'gol Base Camp and overlooking the Vile Reef.

faq.q: What history do these ruins have?
faq.answer: Bal'lal Ruins date to the ancient Gurubashi Empire, before it broke apart into warring jungle troll tribes.

angles.text: As a Darkspear troll of the Horde, you can see ancient Gurubashi glory at Bal'lal, now held by cousin tribes consumed by bloodlust.
From Grom'gol Base Camp, Horde patrols along the shoreline face hostile Bloodscalp trolls at Bal'lal Ruins.
